{{Quote|The Empire was devastating Iliox Argunn's fair world, and in time they would leave one of the galaxy's noblest species little more than wandering paupers.|[[Tem Eliss]]|<ref name="The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx">{{GamerCite|7|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx}}</ref>}}
The '''Anx''' were a large, reptilian [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipeds native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]], a high gravity world located in [[Anx Space]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:HoroxRyyder-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|180px|Horox Ryyder, a male Anx]]
The Anx were a bipedal, reptilian species discernible by their height, their tall crests, and their tails. From a world with higher-than-average [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], the Anx possessed a stooped stature and long necks. Their heads were tall and blade-shaped, with a soaring crest which acted as a [[Sinuses|sinus cavity]]. While their crests changed color to reflect their moods, its primary function gave Anx a low rumbling voice. The [[Anx (language)/Legends|language]] which developed on [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]] was one of loud, low-frequency noises that they could use to communicate across distances of several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. Even after the Anx adopted [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], their low, rumbling voices could uncomfortably vibrate the [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of other species. Another result of the high gravity on their homeworld was a higher then average strength that the species had. Despite their large and sluggish appearance, Anx could be relatively quick when they needed to be. Their skin was also quite thick, having great resistance against blasters, slugthrowers, and many melee weapons. Their strength and their thick skin made an Anx quite a formidable opponent. In order to counter the weight of their large heads, the Anx had a muscular tail which maintained their balance, and could be swung to deliver devastating blows to opponents in combat. Descended from herbivores, their height aided in reaching the bountiful branches of Gravlex Med's [[chiliox tree]]s. Possessing three stomachs, Anx chewed their cud while as part of a vegetarian diet. To compensate for poor [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]], Anx had an acute sense of smell.<ref name="UAA" />

==Society and culture==
Evolving from herd animals, the Anx were a very sociable race known for developing a near fanatical interest in groups they related to. Living in complicated clan structures, Anx enjoy the company of their large families and are more comfortable in groups. Developing spacecraft before encountering other societies, the Anx were curious explorers and fast colonizers. An innate trait among the Anx was a formidable knowledge of anatomy, especially in regard to nerves, muscles and bone structures. Due to this extensive knowledge, even in species they had never encountered, the Anx were considered dangerous unarmed combatants and skilled warriors, capable of defeating most opponents with a single, well-placed attack. Despite this, Anx were generally quite peaceful. While preferring to live without clothing on their homeworld, Anx would wear long flowing robes when traveling to conform to standard galactic customs and views on proper dress. Due to the fact their cranial crests would change color depending on mood, Anx who found themselves in the profession of gambling or diplomacy would often drape their crest with a simple shroud to conceal their feelings.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
[[File:Zo_Howler_and_Fo_Kuna.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zo Howler]] and aide [[Fo Kuna]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].]]
An early spacefaring race, the Anx species had built massive cannons from which they launched spacecraft into space for short-distance [[Realspace/Legends|interstellar]] travel. Colonizing the surrounding planets in what would come to be known as [[Anx Space]], Gravlex Med became the heart of the society. As an unintended consequence of their journeying, the Anx homeworld was [[Conquest of Anx Space|invaded]] briefly by [[Shusugaunt (species)|Shusugaunt]] conquerors. Driven nearly to extinction by the invaders, the Anx eventually found salvation in their world's natural defenses. Unable to survive in the high-gravity ecosystem of Gravlex Med, the Shusugaunt were forced to abandon their conquests and flee the world. At some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the Anx species and accepted them into the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the Republic was replaced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and life on Gravlex Med changed forever. Taking control of [[Gravlex Launchworks]], Imperial mismanagement of the hazardous wastes contained in the factories caused the near extinction of the Anx species and drove all survivors off world.<ref name="UAA" />

==Anx in the galaxy==
[[File:Anx_FDSS_Arden_Beckwith.png|thumb|left|200px|A Force-sensitive Anx.]]
Having been early spacefarers, the Anx possessed many colonies across the region of the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] known as [[Anx Space]]. Extremely sociable beings, the Anx could be found across the galaxy in small numbers, typically remaining in a political atmosphere. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an Anx by the name of [[Pipalidi]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="ORFA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]] represented his people in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was later replaced by former President of Gravlex Med, [[Zo Howler]].<ref name="Hnn-Senator Horox Ryyder Retires">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref> While Anx were rare in the underworld, slave trader [[Graxol Kelvyyn/Legends|Graxol Kelvyyn]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was active during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and was known to frequent [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] such as the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], held on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Rarely producing [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], members of the Anx species had been discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="UAA" /> Because Anx were predisposed to understanding the anatomy of other species they produced many great [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] and [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomats]].<ref name="SS">''[[Savage Spirits]]''</ref> The earliest record Anx Jedi was the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Battlemaster/Legends|battlemaster]] in the years proceeding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], Master [[Skarch Vaunk]]. Venerable and wise, Vaunk was remembered in the Order for authoring several chapters in the ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a handbook which codified many of the Order's bylaws and principals for future generations.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> During the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[J'Mikel]] was an active [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="R28">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref> while [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] took the young Anx [[Theen Fida]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], only to see him die during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]].<ref name="AOW">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref> Decades later, the female [[Madurrin]] achieved Jedi mastery in the [[New Jedi Order|rebuilt Order's]] early years.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
